description: List curated specialty coffee roasters from the database, filtered by country and reputation tier. Useful for finding cafes that serve a given roaster's beans, or planning a roaster-focused trip.

country.description: Filter by ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code.

limit.description: Maximum number of roasters to return. Default 50.

min_reputation.description: Minimum reputation tier. Default: 'notable' (includes all known).

name: list_great_roasters
title: List Great Coffee Roasters
